analysis.title: Lincoln International Inc. (LCLN): 3Q26 EPS: Robust results, and continued, constructive outlook; reiterate Buy
key_insights: LCLN reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $0.46 vs GSe $0.40 and Visible Alpha consensus $0.37, on 11% higher revenue and 2% lower non-comp expenses.
Management described a broadening M&A recovery with near record backlogs, all-time peak pitch activity, and sustained strength in industrials and business services.

LCLN was more constructive on sponsor M&A than peers, citing share gains in sponsor M&A, LP pressure to return capital after extended holding periods, deal activity expanding beyond the highest quality assets, and limited rates headwinds.

Management expects non-M&A advisory to grow faster than M&A advisory into 2027, driven by refinancing demand, cross-selling, and senior talent investment. Capital advisory is supported by elevated borrowing costs, demand for liquidity, and near-term debt maturities of portfolio companies acquired in 2021/22.

Valuations and opinions outlook is constructive on a growing investor base (private wealth, retail), more frequent alts valuations (mid-30s % valued more often than quarterly vs ~30% at IPO), rising private credit complexity, and stronger secondaries growth.
After a large advisory deal pull-forward into 3Q, management expects 4Q revenue toward the lower end of the historical 30-40% annual contribution range.
Management reiterated 2026 comp ratio guidance of ~61% and high-single-digit non-comp dollar growth on a pro forma basis (Marshberry acquisition in 2025), with seasonally higher 4Q non-comps.
GS raised 2026E/28E adjusted EPS by +1%/-1%, rolled the Q5-Q8 P/E multiple forward one quarter at an unchanged 17.0x, and raised the 12-month price target 3% to $29.50 from $28.50. The rating is Buy.
LCLN flagged possible upward pressure on the 2027 tax rate from Section 162(m) expansion, expected to be less pronounced than for peers.

market_movers.rationale: GS raised the price target to $29.50 from $28.50 after 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $0.46 beat consensus, on a constructive M&A and valuations outlook. The target is based on 17.0x P/E on 4Q27E-3Q28E EPS.

sector_views.rationale: GS cites a broadening M&A recovery, near record backlogs, peak pitch activity, and growth in non-M&A advisory and valuations businesses.

earnings_insights: LCLN 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported 11/5 was $0.46 vs GSe $0.40 and Visible Alpha consensus $0.37.
3Q26 revenue was 11% higher year over year per the report's wording. Investment banking advisory revenue reported was $240mn, 11% above consensus.
Valuations and opinions revenue reported was $54mn, 9% above consensus.
Adjusted pre-tax margin reported was 24.8%, about 2.3pp above consensus, with a non-comp ratio of 14.6% (about 1.8pp below consensus) and an in-line adjusted comp ratio.

GS forecasts: 2026E EPS $1.35 (old $1.33), 2027E $1.76 (unchanged), 2028E $2.06 (old $2.08). 2026E revenue is $1,010.6mn (old $1,005.5mn). 4Q26E EPS is $0.48, 1Q27E $0.21, 2Q27E $0.27 (all GS estimates).
GS raised 2027E investment banking advisory revenue by 1% and 2026E/27E/28E valuations and opinions revenue by 4%/2%/2%. Pre-tax margins rise 10bps in each of 2026E/27E/28E.
risk_factors: Continued slowdown in mid-cap and sponsor M&A activity.
Longer time for successful acquisition integration.
Higher 2027 tax rate from Section 162(m) expansion.
